items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Fats Domino's brother-in-law Was playing guitar with me then

ctx.x: Last time I took Fess over there Me and Fess been there again Then I passed that several times by myself Well we played good violin together Fats Domino's brother-in-law Was playing guitar with me then Harrison Oh Harrison The one taught him to play the piano And he won't give him a job You know that's dirty Now he taught him to play the piano By chord And showed him how to make the chords On the piano He don't

He won't give his brother-in-law a job right now. That's how big his head done, guy. The boy would show him how to play. Won't give him a job. Now, you know, that ain't right. I wouldn't call that fair. You gave me something that you didn't have to give me. You give it to me to make my bread. I made bread with it. I made big bread with it.
